title: TGA Comparison: R1 Batches

asks.ask: 각 배치 200–450 °C 구간 질량 변화량(W200 − W450, wt%)을 계산해서 범례 라벨에 같이 넣어 주세요.

code:
import numpy as np
handles, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = []
for line, label in zip(handles, labels):
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    if len(x_data) == 0:
        new_labels.append(label)
        continue
    sort_idx = np.argsort(x_data)
    x_sorted = x_data[sort_idx]
    y_sorted = y_data[sort_idx]
    w_200 = np.interp(200, x_sorted, y_sorted)
    w_450 = np.interp(450, x_sorted, y_sorted)
    delta_w = w_200 - w_450
    new_labels.append(f"{label} (ΔW: {delta_w:.2f} wt%)")
ax1.legend(handles, new_labels)
